X, Y, N = map(int, input().split())

bestA = -1
bestB = -1

def update(a, b):
    global bestA, bestB
    if a < 0:
        return
    if bestA == -1:
        bestA = a
        bestB = b
        return
    diffA = abs(bestB * X - bestA * Y) * b
    diffB = abs(b * X - a * Y) * bestB
    if diffA > diffB:
        bestA = a
        bestB = b
    elif diffA == diffB and (b < bestB or (b == bestB and a < bestA)):
        bestA = a
        bestB = b

for i in range(1, N + 1):
    val = i * X // Y
    update(val - 1, i)
    update(val, i)
    update(val + 1, i)

print(f"{bestA}/{bestB}")
